mapper.select: /* mybatis.mapper.idmapping.getKtIdByCredentialIdFallback : CREDENTIAL_ID 기반 폴백으로 KT_ID를 조회한다. */ SELECT A.KT_ID FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CREDENTIAL_ID = ( SELECT B.CREDENTIAL_ID FROM TB_USER_KT B WHERE (B.USER_ID = #{userId} OR B.SNS_TEMP_ID = #{userId}) AND B.CREDENTIAL_ID IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 ) AND A.KT_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.KT_ID != '' LIMIT 1

/* mybatis.mapper.idmapping.getKtIdByUserId : USER_ID로 TB_USER에서 KT_ID를 조회한다. */ SELECT A.KT_ID FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CREDENTIAL_ID = ( SELECT B.CREDENTIAL_ID FROM TB_USER B WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) AND A.KT_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.KT_ID != '' LIMIT 1

/* mybatis.mapper.idmapping.getKtIdByCredentialId : credential_id로 TB_USER에서 KT_ID를 조회한다. */ SELECT KT_ID FROM TB_USER WHERE CREDENTIAL_ID = #{credentialId} AND KT_ID IS NOT NULL AND KT_ID != '' LIMIT 1

/* mybatis.mapper.idmapping.getOldSnsIdByCredentialId : credential_id로 기존 SNS 임시 ID를 조회한다. */ SELECT CASE WHEN SNS_TEMP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN SNS_TEMP_ID WHEN USER_ID LIKE 'SNS!%' THEN USER_ID ELSE USER_ID END AS OLD_SNS_ID FROM TB_USER_KT WHERE CREDENTIAL_ID = #{credentialId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: /* mybatis.mapper.idmapping.deleteSnsRecord : SNS 임시 레코드를 삭제한다. */ DELETE FROM TB_USER_KT WHERE USER_ID = #{oldSnsId}
mapper.update: /* mybatis.mapper.idmapping.updateKtRecordWithSnsInfo : KT 레코드에 SNS 이력을 갱신한다. */ UPDATE TB_USER_KT SET SNS_TEMP_ID = #{snsTemporaryId}, CREDENTIAL_ID = COALESCE(#{credentialId}, CREDENTIAL_ID), MOD_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
